tips: 1- Bank name, SWIFT code, bank country will be auto retrieved from account number / IABN.
2- Beneficiary name must be two syllables with minimum 3 characters each.
3- If destination country is united states of America, routing number will be displayed once country is chosen.
4- If destination country is Canada, transit number will be displayed as mandatory field once country is chosen.
5- If destination country is Australia, BSB number will be displayed as a mandatory field once country is chosen.
6- If destination country is India, IFSC code will be displayed as a mandatory field once country is chosen.
